message:
Keep the live score on relink — attach audio only, propagate new source path (#367) (#439)

finishRelink used to re-fire onProjectScoreReady with the file's saved extras, silently discarding unsaved edits and the undo stack. Relink now only reattaches verified audio: enterSourceMissing retries skip the score restore, the new verified source path flows to the host via onProjectRelinked (dirty baseline + recordings-prune index), and the next save writes it back.

Co-authored-by: Devin <158243242+devin-ai-integration[bot]@users.noreply.github.com>
